scope.actualStoreLocalRoute: Diagnostic trace markers around each synthetic boolean and separate recipe prepare/rebuild stages only; absent markers mean unavailable, never zero-success proof. Mesh/quality work is excluded, and trace durations are never timing evidence. Local successes are not inferred from the requested setting.
scope.incidence: Matching boundary-ordered graph encodings establish a bijection preserving endpoint, use, wire, loop, face, shell and root aliases. Indistinguishable ordering ties may reject isomorphic graphs; this is not a complete graph-isomorphism solver. Attributes and journal semantics remain separate contracts.
scope.adoption: Qualification of listed inputs only. Default unchanged; general imported-body, cavity, NURBS, identity and lineage adoption require separate evidence.
